scripts.build:runner: esbuild src/sandbox/agent-runner.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=dist/sandbox/runner.bundle.mjs
scripts.runner:image:build: pnpm build:runner && docker build -t localhost:5050/my-discord-agent-runner:latest . && docker push localhost:5050/my-discord-agent-runner:latest
